summary: Jersey Central Power & Light Co. filed an 8-K to disclose an extension of its exchange offer for three series of senior notes. The offer seeks to exchange up to $350M of 4.150% notes due 2029, $500M of 4.400% notes due 2031, and $500M of 5.150% notes due 2036 for registered notes of the same principal amount. The expiration was extended from June 1, 2026 to June 15, 2026. No premium, price, or board recommendation was disclosed. This is a routine registration-exchange transaction, not a special situation.
